title: RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.22138v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchica

translated_title: RoboTeam：面向多机械臂实时视觉多智能体控制的基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体现在可以通过调用工具和编写代码来控制机械臂。现有基准测试在三个方面存在不足：大多数只在短任务中测试一两个机械臂，许多基准在智能体思考时会暂停环境，许多基准还会向智能体提供物体的真实位置信息。我们提出了RoboTeam，这是一个模拟基准测试，智能体仅凭相机图像实时控制4到16个机械臂。其36个任务是机械臂必须协作完成的长时作业，例如传递木材或用数百个立方体拼出一幅图画。我们从最灵活的智能体系统——自适应系统开始，其中一个智能体决定何时分派出代理智能体。在该系统下，gpt-6.1-sol和opus-5.5分别完成了28和27个任务，而其他四个模型最多只完成3个。但代价高昂：一个典型任务需要gpt-6.1-sol花费3.5小时和2.18亿输入token，并且其三分之一的步骤至少失败一次、必须重试。随后我们将其与三种固定系统进行比较：单智能体、分层……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: RoboTeam是一个仅凭相机图像实时协同控制4至16个机械臂、包含36项长时协作任务的模拟基准，揭示了自适应多智能体系统虽然完成任务数最多（28/36），但需要付出数小时耗时和上亿token的高昂代价。
en_tdlr: RoboTeam is a simulated benchmark where multimodal agents control 4–16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone across 36 long collaborative tasks, showing that the adaptive multi-agent system completes the most tasks (28/36) but at a steep cost of hours of runtime and hundreds of millions of tokens.
